test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The UN system is based on six principal organs. Which of the following organs does NOT come under it?

options.text: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations

solution:
The correct answer is __**Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Six Principal Organs of the UN System **

 
 
• **The General Assembly**

 
 
• Th**e UN's primary organ for deliberation, formulating policy, and representation** is the General Assembly.
 
• The General Assembly is the only UN body having representation from all **193 of its member states**.**​​**
 
 
 
• **The Security Council**
 
 
• According to the UN Charter, the Security Council is in charge of maintaining **global peace and security**.
 
• It has 15 members (5 permanent and 10 non-permanent members).
 
 
 
• **The Economic and Social Council**
 
 
• Responsible for** fostering interstate cooperation** in economic and social concerns.
 
• It coordinates cooperation among the **several specialised agencies of the UN**.
 
• It has **54 members **that are elected by the General Assembly for staggered three-year terms.
 
 
 
• **The UN Secretariat**
 
 
• It provide**s administrative support **to the other UN bodies.
 
• The UN's chief representative is the **UN Secretary-General**, who is chosen by the General Assembly for a **five-year term**.
 
 
 
• **The International Court of Justice**
 
 
• Issues **lega**l advice.
 
• Renders judgment by a **relative majority**.
 
• Decides conflicts between governments that acknowledge its **jurisdiction**.
 
• For nine-year terms, the UN General Assembly elects its** fifteen judges**.
 
 
 
• **The Trusteeship Council**
 
 
• It was originally created to **oversee colonial lands** that had already been League of Nations mandates.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **United Nations (UN) System **

 
 
• The UN System is made up of **subsidiary organisations such as independently managed funds and programs, research and training centers, and other subsidiary agencies**.
 
• Some of these groups were left over from the** League of Nations disintegration** and existed before the United Nations was established in **1945**.
 
• The **World Trade Organization**, which is not officially a part of the United Nations System, and some executive heads of United Nations System organisations have seats on the **United Nations System Chief Executives Board for Coordination (CEB)**.
 
• This group, presided over by the **UN Secretary-General, meets twice a year** to coordinate the efforts of the UN System's entities.
